packages.name: base-os
packages.summary: Base operating system virtual package providing /bin/sh and core OS tools
packages.description:
Base operating system package providing the POSIX shell (/bin/sh),
core filesystem utilities, and essential command-line tools required
to bootstrap a functional system environment.

packages.name: zopen-release
packages.summary: zopen repository and DNF configuration for /opt/pkg
packages.description:
Provides repository definitions, DNF configurations, and creates the required
filesystem directory tree under /opt/pkg.
